correctness.rationale: For character order >=9, pair-sum orthogonality gives the exact convolution energy with only collisions 0+2=1+1 and 0+4=2+2. Two elementary square inequalities yield a symmetric quadratic majorant. At the isolated root of an explicitly given ninth-degree polynomial the stationary positive vector is verified by exact symbolic identities. Strict diagonal dominance of the zero-sum restriction, proved from rational interval bounds, makes the majorant globally sharp and its equality unique. Equality in the two convolution-fiber triangles fixes all phases. The four smaller distinct-support orders have strict positive aliasing witnesses. Source: full derivation and checker.py; finite experiments are only supplementary.
